obfuscation_indicators: excluding the impact of the Vitro Acquisition
risk_summary: The disclosure is highly quantified and provides useful reconciliations of sales, volumes, pricing, currency effects, and acquisition impacts. Risk factors include higher debt and interest expense from the Vitro Acquisition, foreign-exchange pressure, competitive pricing declines, regional economic slowdowns, and recurring reliance on management-defined exclusions and non-GAAP segment measures.
